t: 亨利·克莱向美国国会介绍了1850年的妥协.
te: Henry Clay introduces the Compromise of 1850 to the U.S. Congress.
dz: 亨利·克莱向美国国会介绍了1850年的妥协.
de: Henry Clay introduces the Compromise of 1850 to the U.S. Congress.

t: 布里格姆·杨在犹他堡战役中向蒂姆帕诺戈斯宣战.
te: Brigham Young declares war on Timpanogos in the Battle at Fort Utah.
dz: 布里格姆·杨在犹他堡战役中向蒂姆帕诺戈斯宣战.
de: Brigham Young declares war on Timpanogos in the Battle at Fort Utah.

t: 昂格尔西岛和威尔士大陆之间跨越梅奈海峡的不列颠大桥已经开通.
te: The Britannia Bridge across the Menai Strait between the island of Anglesey and the mainland of Wales is opened.
dz: 昂格尔西岛和威尔士大陆之间跨越梅奈海峡的不列颠大桥已经开通.
de: The Britannia Bridge across the Menai Strait between the island of Anglesey and the mainland of Wales is opened.

t: 参议员丹尼尔·韦伯斯特(Daniel Webster)发表"三月七日"演说,赞同1850年的妥…
te: Senator Daniel Webster gives his "Seventh of March" speech endorsing the Compromise of 1850 in order to prevent a possi…
dz: 参议员丹尼尔·韦伯斯特(Daniel Webster)发表"三月七日"演说,赞同1850年的妥协,以防止可能的内战.
de: Senator Daniel Webster gives his "Seventh of March" speech endorsing the Compromise of 1850 in order to prevent a possible civil war.

t: 阿拉纳-南方条约被批准,结束了大不列颠和阿根廷之间的"现存分歧".
te: The Arana–Southern Treaty is ratified, ending "the existing differences" between Great Britain and Argentina.
dz: 阿拉纳-南方条约被批准,结束了大不列颠和阿根廷之间的"现存分歧".
de: The Arana–Southern Treaty is ratified, ending "the existing differences" between Great Britain and Argentina.

t: 美国有色劳工联盟(英语:American League of Colored Laborers…
te: The American League of Colored Laborers, the first African American labor union in the United States, is established in…
dz: 美国有色劳工联盟(英语:American League of Colored Laborers)是美国第一个非裔美国劳工联盟,成立于纽约市.
de: The American League of Colored Laborers, the first African American labor union in the United States, is established in New York City.

t: 荷兰公主路易丝与瑞典王储卡尔-挪威结婚.
te: Princess Louise of the Netherlands marries Crown Prince Karl of Sweden–Norway.
dz: 荷兰公主路易丝与瑞典王储卡尔-挪威结婚.
de: Princess Louise of the Netherlands marries Crown Prince Karl of Sweden–Norway.

t: 由君士坦丁堡普世牧首府自动正式授予希腊教会.

dz: 由君士坦丁堡普世牧首府自动正式授予希腊教会.

te: Persian prophet Báb is executed in Tabriz, Persia.
dz: 波斯先知巴布被处决于波斯大不里士.
de: Persian prophet Báb is executed in Tabriz, Persia.

t: 美国总统扎卡里·泰勒在食用生水果和冰牛奶后死亡；他的继任者是副总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔。
te: U.S. President Zachary Taylor dies after eating raw fruit and iced milk; he is succeeded in office by Vice President Mi…
dz: 美国总统扎卡里·泰勒在食用生水果和冰牛奶后死亡；他的继任者是副总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔。
de: U.S. President Zachary Taylor dies after eating raw fruit and iced milk; he is succeeded in office by Vice President Millard Fillmore.

t: 美国总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔宣誓就职,在扎卡里·泰勒去世后成为总统的第二天.
te: U.S. President Millard Fillmore is sworn in, a day after becoming president upon Zachary Taylor's death.
dz: 美国总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔宣誓就职,在扎卡里·泰勒去世后成为总统的第二天.
de: U.S. President Millard Fillmore is sworn in, a day after becoming president upon Zachary Taylor's death.

t: 维加成为第一颗被拍照的恒星(除太阳外).
te: Vega becomes the first star (other than the Sun) to be photographed.
dz: 维加成为第一颗被拍照的恒星(除太阳外).
de: Vega becomes the first star (other than the Sun) to be photographed.

t: 理查德·瓦格纳的"洛亨格林"(Lohengrin)在斯泰特斯卡佩尔·魏玛(Staatskape…

dz: 理查德·瓦格纳的"洛亨格林"(Lohengrin)在斯泰特斯卡佩尔·魏玛(Staatskapelle Weimar)首映.
de: Richard Wagner's Lohengrin premieres at the Staatskapelle Weimar.

t: 加利福尼亚州被承认为美国第 31 个州。
te: California is admitted as the thirty-first U.S. state.
dz: 加利福尼亚州被承认为美国第 31 个州。
de: California is admitted as the thirty-first U.S. state.

t: 1850年的"妥协"将德克萨斯州三分之一的地权被联邦控制,以换取美国联邦政府承担德克萨斯州吞并…
te: The Compromise of 1850 transfers a third of Texas's claimed territory to federal control in return for the U.S. federal…
dz: 1850年的"妥协"将德克萨斯州三分之一的地权被联邦控制,以换取美国联邦政府承担德克萨斯州吞并前1000万美元的债务.
de: The Compromise of 1850 transfers a third of Texas's claimed territory to federal control in return for the U.S. federal government assuming $10 million of Texas's pre-annexation debt.

t: 美国国会通过了1850年"逃亡奴隶法".
te: The U.S. Congress passes the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850.
dz: 美国国会通过了1850年"逃亡奴隶法".
de: The U.S. Congress passes the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850.

dz: 暴动开始,导致阿勒颇大屠杀.

dz: 第一届美国全国妇女权利大会在马萨诸塞州伍斯特开幕。

dz: 条约"奥尔穆茨的封号"在奥洛穆克签订. 普鲁士向奥地利投降,奥地利将接任德意志邦联的领导.
de: The treaty, Punctation of Olmütz, is signed in Olomouc. Prussia capitulates to Austria, which will take over the leadership of the German Confederation.
